trigger.Name: HELPHELPHELP
trigger.script:
-- Create enemy team TeamCreate("Razboy", 1015, CVector(4072, 306, 1765), {"Ural00", "Molokovoz02", "r2m1_Fighter02"}, CVector(4011, 306, 1405), 1)
CinemaFiltersUse() SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
-- ?? Attempt to boost AI speed for all team vehicles local teamVehicles = GetTeamVehicles("Razboy") if teamVehicles then for _, veh in pairs(teamVehicles) do if veh and veh.UnlimitMaxSpeed then veh:UnlimitMaxSpeed() veh:SetMaxSpeed(1000) veh:SetCruisingSpeed(800) println("[Razboy AI] Speed unlocked for " .. veh:GetName()) end end else println("[Razboy AI] No vehicles found in team.") end
TActivate("trVehSTOP")
-- Setup cinematic view around the player local Plf = GetPlayerVehicle() local PlfID = GetPlayerVehicleId() local PlfCoor = Plf:GetPosition() PlfCoor.x = PlfCoor.x - 5 PlfCoor.y = PlfCoor.y + 5 PlfCoor.z = PlfCoor.z - 35
FlyAround(1, 0, 25, 6, PlfCoor, PlfID, 1, 1) StartCinematic()
AddCinematicMessage(14, 1) TActivate("HELPHELPHELP_ce") CompleteQuest("d_HelpSideVillageSNG_Quest1")
trigger:Deactivate()
